title: Design language
noPublished: This design language has no published version.

state.invalid: Not saved: fix the marked fields

publish.title: Publish the draft?
publish.body: Once published, new productions use these rules. You can go back to an earlier version at any time.
publish.notePlaceholder: e.g. Secondary lines got a bit smaller
publish.disabledHint: No difference from the published version, or a field has an error.

discard.title: Discard the draft?
discard.body: Unpublished changes are deleted. The published version stays as it is.

empty.title: You have no design language yet
empty.body: A design language describes how your labels are written: which fonts, which line is large, how the & sign sits, where lines break. Everything is produced from these rules; your own style lives here, not in code.
empty.step2: Upload your finished labels in Create; work out its rules together with AI.
empty.step3: Try it with sample orders and publish if you are happy.
empty.dialogBody: An empty language is created with default values; you edit its rules afterwards.

schema.label: Sample label diagram showing the line ratios
schema.caption: The number on the right is the line's ratio to the main line; the purple measure is the gap between lines.

summary.draftNote: The text below describes the unpublished draft.

rules.saveFailed: The draft could not be saved. {{message}} The faulty fields are marked; it saves on its own once you fix them.

preview.withPublished: With the published version, free engine
preview.status: Live preview · no AI, no cost · Ø {{mm}} mm
preview.name: Preview
preview.schemaTip: Not the engine itself; shows the proportions of the lines.

fonts.empty: No fonts yet. Use “Add font” to pick from the uploaded fonts.
fonts.missing: The font file was not found.
fonts.notePlaceholder: A short note shown to the AI and to you
fonts.loadFailed: The uploaded fonts could not be read.
fonts.noneToAdd: No new fonts to add. To upload a font, go to Settings > Fonts.

glyphs.empty: No special character rules. For example, you can print “&” in another font at half size.

match.word-initial-upper: Capital at the start of a word
match.line-initial-upper: Capital at the start of a line

glyphs.scale: Size (multiple of the line's point size)
glyphs.onlyWith: Only together with these fonts (empty = any font)
glyphs.needFonts: Add a font in the Fonts group first.

chips.placeholder: Type and press Enter; separate several with commas

scales.ratioOf: Ratio of the connector {{word}} (to the main line)
scales.wordLabel: Connector to add a custom ratio for

examples.empty: No examples. Showing how you want a text split is stronger than writing a rule.

cut.points: Corner points (one per line: x, y)

sheets.name: Sheet name
sheets.keywords: This sheet if the product name contains any of these (empty = default sheet)

versions.title: Versions
versions.loadFailed: The versions could not be read
versions.empty: No versions yet. The history appears here once you publish the first rules.
versions.first: This is the first version; there is no earlier version to compare.
versions.noDiff: There is no rule difference between these two versions.
versions.revertBody: This version's rules are published as a NEW version and become active right away. The versions in between are not deleted; you can switch back at any time.
versions.reverted: The rules of version {{from}} were published as new version {{to}}.
versions.revertHint: Going back publishes this version's rules as a new version; the versions in between are not deleted.

motor.label: Exact
motor.hint: The engine always applies this exactly.

ai.label: Guides the AI
ai.hint: The AI reads this and decides accordingly; it is not enforced.

ikisi.label: Both
ikisi.hint: The AI is told, and the engine also checks the result.

sistem.label: System
sistem.hint: Affects how the app behaves, not the production.

fonts.none: No usable fonts have been added yet.

mixing.single: A label uses a single font family (except special characters).
mixing.two: A label uses at most two font families.
mixing.free: The font family on a label is free.

fonts.upperRun: {{font}} is used for text with at most {{n}} capitals in a row.
fonts.lockTracking: The letter spacing of {{font}} is left untouched.

glyphs.none: There are no special character rules; every letter is set in its line's own font.

glyph.wordInitialLetters: Capital {{letters}} at the start of a word
glyph.wordInitial: Capitals at the start of a word
glyph.lineInitialLetters: Capital {{letters}} at the start of a line
glyph.lineInitial: Capitals at the start of a line

size.fillLocked: The text fills {{fill}} of the area; this is the same in every design.
size.fillFree: The text fills {{fill}} of the area; the AI may change this if needed.
size.tiers: Secondary lines are {{secondary}} of the main line, tertiary lines {{tertiary}}, and a lone connector {{connector}}.
size.tiersLocked: The engine applies these ratios; the AI only picks which class a line belongs to.
size.tiersFree: The AI may choose line sizes that differ from the ratios.
size.limits: Capital height is at most {{cap}} of the cut diameter; the point size stays between {{min}} and {{max}}.
size.initialsOneLine: Text that is only initials is never stacked.

spacing.gaps: The gap between lines is {{normal}} of the small line, {{beforeLast}} before the last date line, and {{connector}} around a lone connector.

connectors.dangling: A connector left dangling at the start or end of a line goes on its own line.
connectors.symbolSpacing: Breathing space is added around symbols like “&” when needed.
connectors.shiftRight: A connector between two names shifts {{n}} em to the right.
connectors.shiftLeft: A connector between two names shifts {{n}} em to the left.
connectors.scale: The connector “{{word}}” is {{pct}} the size of the main line.

lineBreaking.nameOwnLine: The name is on its own line and is the largest line.

couple.always: Couple names are always stacked as name / connector / name.
couple.option: For couple names, stacking is tried as one of the candidates.

lineBreaking.dateOwnLine: The date stays on a separate line.
lineBreaking.limits: A line has at most {{chars}} characters and a label at most {{lines}} lines; most labels have {{min}}–{{max}} lines.

customer.hint: The line breaks the customer gave count as a hint.
customer.strict: The line breaks the customer gave are applied exactly.
customer.ignore: The line breaks the customer gave are ignored.

lineBreaking.noLone: These never stand alone on a line: {{list}}.
lineBreaking.examples: The AI is shown {{n}} example breaks.

weight.stroke: The text is thickened with a thin outline in its own color, {{n}} em of the main line's point size.
weight.real: The font's bold style is used for weight.
weight.colorAuto: The text color is {{color}}; on a dark background it switches to {{dark}} on its own.

sticker.on: Sticker orders are on ({{detect}}); {{n}} sheets defined.

detect.product-field: orders that have a product field

quality.line: A variation scoring below {{score}} is flagged “check”; anything under {{pt}} pt gives a warning.
